# stalwart_dns_server_google_cloud_dns (Resource)

Defines a DNS server for automatic record management. Manages the Google Cloud DNS variant.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `description` (String) Short description of this DNS server
- `project_id` (String) The Google Cloud project ID that owns the managed zone
- `service_account_json` (Attributes) Service account JSON credentials used to authenticate with Google Cloud (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--service_account_json))

### Optional

- `impersonate_service_account` (String) Optional service account email to impersonate
- `managed_zone` (String) Managed zone name (resolved automatically by longest suffix match if not set)
- `member_tenant_id` (String) Identifier for the tenant this DNS server belongs to
- `polling_interval` (Number) How often to check for DNS records to propagate
- `private_zone` (Boolean) Whether to restrict zone resolution to private zones only
- `propagation_delay` (Number) Initial delay before first propagation check (useful for slow providers)
- `propagation_timeout` (Number) How long to wait for DNS records to propagate
- `timeout` (Number) Request timeout for the DNS server
- `ttl` (Number) The TTL for new DNS record

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Server-assigned identifier.

<a id="nestedatt--service_account_json"></a>
### Nested Schema for `service_account_json`

Required:

- `type` (String) Variant discriminator.

Optional:

- `file_path` (String) File path to read the secret from
- `secret` (String, Sensitive) Password or secret value
- `variable_name` (String) Environment variable name to read the secret from
